# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-17T17:51Z · next run ~23:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-18T07:51Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 27 measured from open data, 14 follow a published figure, 48 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 39/100 (Unsettled) · 13 Alert · 46 Watch · 30 Normal Headline: Gulf war keeps oil, shipping and freight on Alert as Iran fires more drones at Bahrain on 17 Nov; France–Bund spread holds above 150bp; UK October inflation is due on 18 Nov.
## Situations (7 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, worsening]: Iran fired drones at a US radar site in Bahrain on 17 Nov after attacks on 13 and 15 Nov; tankers hit in Hormuz 16–17 Nov; US blockade goes on. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, eu-gas, chokepoints, freight; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, oil, fertiliser, uk-energy-cap, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, stable]: Russian strikes killed 14 across Ukraine in the day to 17 Nov and closed Kyiv's two main bridges; Estonia will shut its Russian border on 1 Dec. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.46 for Aug–Oct; global temperature +1.88°C on 11 Nov, a record for the date; CO₂ growth 2.35 ppm/yr in the week of 8 Nov. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: DR Congo Ebola reached 11,197 confirmed cases and 5,471 deaths by 11 Nov (ECDC); WHO emergency since 17 May remains in force. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: FEWS NET says Famine risk has spread to South Darfur; the army said it broke the RSF siege of El Obeid on 14 Nov; fighting goes on in Kordofan. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, worsening]: France–Bund 10-year spread closed at 155bp on 16 Nov, above the 150bp Alert line in 11 of 16 sessions since 26 Oct; no failed auction. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US prices rose 0.4% in Oct after 3.7% y/y in Sep; a December Fed rise is near fully priced; BoE at 4%; UK October CPI due 18 Nov. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility, gilts; normal: em-stress
## Other Alerts - Cholera & mosquito-borne [cholera-dengue] stable, AI-judged: WHO counts over 3,000 cholera deaths in 2026, nearly nine in ten in Africa; Sudan and Yemen among worst affected - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 17 Nov
## Changed in last 24h - Sovereign debt stress [sovereign-debt]: WATCH→ALERT — France–Bund 10-year spread widened to 155bp on 16 Nov, above the 150bp Alert line for most sessions since late Oct (2026-11-17T17:51Z) - UK weather warnings [uk-weather]: WATCH→NORMAL — Met Office lists no weather warnings at 11:40 UK on 17 Nov after the morning's yellow snow warnings lapsed (2026-11-17T11:42Z) - Pacific & Indian cyclones [other-cyclones]: NORMAL→WATCH — GDACS orange alert for Cyclone Akvan in the Bay of Bengal; IMD expects landfall in Andhra Pradesh by noon on 20 Nov (2026-11-16T23:43Z) - US equity stress [equity-stress]: NORMAL→WATCH — VIX 21.6 on 16 Nov, above the 20 Watch line, as tech selling pushed the S&P 500 4.7% below its high (2026-11-16T17:52Z)
## Watch (ids; detail at /s/{id}.md) equity-stress, bond-volatility, gold, crypto, private-credit, us-inflation, central-banks, oil, food-prices, critical-minerals, fertiliser, nuclear-plants, us-china, russia-nato, iran-nuclear, korea, trade-war, sanctions, hybrid-threats, drc-east, sahel, myanmar, india-pakistan, nuclear-risk, other-conflicts, other-cyclones, heat, drought, sea-ice, co2, who-emergencies, mpox, measles, respiratory, medicine-shortages, cyber, cables-gnss, semiconductors, ai-governance, famine, civil-unrest, aid-funding, uk-rates, gilts, uk-energy-cap, nhs-pressure
